description: Lioroma wears a full-length muted red textured gown with a low square neckline, fitted structured bodice and elbow-length shaped sleeves. Cream-and-gold floral-geometric trim decorates the neckline, waist, sleeves and lower hem. A cream patterned underlayer is visible down the skirt center. A brown-grey mantle with matching decorative borders rests loosely along the arms. The waist belt has small metal fittings and a round clasp with a hanging end. A small pendant, earrings and ring provide restrained jewelry. Dark closed shoes show under the skirt. Fabric appears wool-like or plush over woven undercloth, with exact fibers uncertain. No headgear, armor or weapon appears.
